title: Unable to download docker-compose binary: HttpError: self signed certificate in certificate chain
body: ### Bug description Hello, Can't install podman compose from podman desktop. I have this message: ``` Unable to download docker-compose binary: HttpError: self signed certificate in certificate chain ``` Seems releated to https://github.com/podman-desktop/podman-desktop/issues/9826 Like issue 9826, my company use a transparent proxy. The PR of this issue was merged in 1.18.0 but I still have the issue in 1.20.2. ### Operating system Windows 11 ### Installation Method Installer from website/GitHub releases ### Version 1.20.0 ### Steps to reproduce - Go to extensions - Select "Onboarding Compose" to instal the compose extension - Select "Next" to proceed install ### Relevant log output ```shell main ↪️ [podman] Podman extension: Autostarting machine podman-machine-default main ↪️ Engine does not have an API or a libpod API, returning empty array Podman main ↪️ [podman] Can't get machine podman-machine-default resource usage error Error: no running provider for the matching container main ↪️ [kind] kind extension is active main ↪️ [podman] Can't get machine podman-machine-default resource usage error Error: no running provider for the matching container main ↪️ [compose] Error trying to run the version on docker-compose. Binary might not be there Error: Failed to execute command: spawn docker-compose ENOENT main ↪️ [compose] GET /repos/docker/compose/releases - 500 with id UNKNOWN in 64ms main ↪️ [compose] GET /repos/docker/compose/releases - 500 with id UNKNOWN in 53ms ``` ### Additional context My company certificates are installed both in root and intermediate authority store.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: @reporter I have no issues to install and everything seems to work smooth. PD downloading from github releases directly https://github.com/docker/compose/releases so there should be no permanent certificate issues. Do you have the same issue when you are downloading kubectl CLI? Are you behind proxy?

comments.body: Hello, As I mentioned previously, I believe my issue is similar to the one described in https://github.com/podman-desktop/podman-desktop/issues/9826, which involves a transparent proxy. > Many corporate users will be behind a transparent proxy. This means that HTTPS connections will be intercepted and the corporate certificate will be inserted. Clients will fail to validate the connection, displaying a 'self-signed' certificate error, unless we add the corporate certificate to the root of trust. This is all very common and boring. If I try to install it at home, no issue at all. I looked through the code and found [compose-github-releases.ts](https://github.com/podman-desktop/podman-desktop/blob/2dcdf6629f5aaf4eb3eff59359a02e4c5c82681c/extensions/compose/src/compose-github-releases.ts#L31) that uses the Octokit library to fetch data from GitHub. @reporter Download for Compose goes through proxy configuration and if system proxy is not detected properly it does not use local Certificates.

What is your `Proxy Configuration` value in Proxy settings? If it is 'System' could you try to use 'Manual' configuration and see if that helps?
